high_level_description: This image depicts a dramatic scene of a jet aircraft flying over a vibrant sunset or sunrise. The sky is divided into distinct layers of color, transitioning from deep blue at the top to lighter shades of blue, white, and orange near the horizon. The sun is partially obscured by the curvature of the Earth, creating a striking silhouette effect. The jet aircraft is positioned centrally in the image, flying at a high altitude. It appears to be a modern fighter jet, characterized by its sleek design and pointed nose.
